fun_facts: As a kid growing up in Lafayette, Jack Bech’s family drove to the Superdome to watch the Saints; his uncle Brett played for New Orleans in the 1990s.
At St. Thomas More, Jack Bech also played basketball, and his team won three straight state championships from 2019 to 2021.
Jack Bech finished high school with 173 catches for 3,236 yards and 37 touchdowns in 35 games.
In 2024 at TCU, Jack Bech caught 62 passes for 1,034 yards and nine touchdowns; his receiving-yard total ranked fourth in school history for a season.
At the 2025 Senior Bowl, Jack Bech caught the game-winning touchdown on the final play and was named the game’s MVP.

basis.reasoning: The college listing gives LSU followed by TCU, making TCU the last college listed. The NFL player profile also identifies TCU as Jack Bech’s college.

excerpts:
-- New Orleans is where Jack Bech's love for football first formed.

As a kid, Bech's family would drive two hours east from their home in Lafayette, La., to the Superdome to watch the Saints, the team his uncle Brett played for in the 1990s. New Orleans was where Jack first competed on an NFL field while playing for St. Thomas More Catholic High in Louisiana's Division II Select state title game at the end of his sophomore season.

It was where his family last felt whole, where they spent Christmas together in 2024.
